description: This script automates the process of re-posting stock entries and related ledger entries for manufacturing work orders missing batch numbers, including recalculations and updates in ERPNext.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to process and repost stock entries for manufacturing work orders missing batch numbers.

methods.name: set_expense_account
methods.description: Sets the expense account for items in a stock entry if not already set.

methods.name: repost_stock_entry
methods.description: Updates and reposts a stock entry and its child items, including ledger entries.

methods.name: get_sle_for_target_warehouse
methods.description: Generates stock ledger entries for the target warehouse based on stock entry items.

methods.name: repost_future_sle_and_gle
methods.description: Creates a reposting entry for item valuation based on the stock entry.
